requirements: Call doomgeneric_Create(argc, argv) once; then schedule doomgeneric_Tick() cooperatively.
Use emscripten_sleep in DG_SleepMs (ASYNCIFY is enabled) so engine waits yield; do not spin or block the browser.
Keep runtime alive after main returns (EXIT_RUNTIME=0); avoid re-entering a tick while an Asyncify suspension is active.

callbacks.owner: video/input coder for DG_Init, DG_DrawFrame, DG_GetKey, DG_SetWindowTitle; coordinate DG_SleepMs and DG_GetTicksMs with runtime coder

browser.startup: Module.noInitialRun=true; Start button invokes Module.callMain(Module.arguments) only after onRuntimeInitialized
browser.renderer: Canvas 2D owned by C/EM_JS callbacks; page creates no context. Convert B,G,R,0 to opaque R,G,B,A.
browser.input: Register browser input in C/EM_JS platform; canvas tabindex=0 and Start/click focus it. Page does not translate keys.

build.engine_sources: explicit array in build.sh; all supplied .c except icon.c (include data)

unresolved_dependencies: Platform main missing; final build fails deliberately with undefined exported _main.
Platform callbacks are still supplied empty stubs. Runtime and video/input coders must implement them before gameplay verification.
